image_prompts: A digital clock displaying the current time with emphasis on the seconds ticking

words.image_desc_cn: 与庆祝活动相关的彩色装饰品和传统食物。
words.collocations: annual festival, music festival, film festival

image_prompts: A hand gripping a subway pole tightly as the train brakes suddenly

words.collocations: car race, horse race, human race

image_prompts: A heart-shaped pendant with a sparkling gemstone in the center, soft lighting

words.image_desc_cn: 心形吊坠和情书。
